scope: Foundation lifecycle conformance only. Controlled starting board and Force; injected production HitCardEffect then production relocation/restoration/exclusion/capture/hand-return effects during a real initiated battle. Production required rules execute normally. Not a claim of legal named-card departure action coverage or a complete match.
findings: Hit movement and exclusion cause immediate target and attachment loss while another ally keeps the battle active.
Capturing a hit character or occupied starship does not restore hit: captive/inactive target and attachments are lost by the required rule.
Restoration before relocation preserves the target and its attached weapon.
Returning the hit character to hand ends the table instance and clears hit; attachment is lost by ordinary return handling. No subsequent loss of the hand card occurs.
attempts: Initial test compilation failed because getBlueprintId requires a boolean; driver corrected.
Second execution stopped at mandatory Lost Pile ordering; driver corrected to select an observed offered cardId.
Third execution completed six cases with no failures.

officialRule.summary: A hit card not participating in battle or attack is immediately lost. Restoring removes hit; leaving table ends the instance.
